rows.definition: Checked per-owner request word counts, aggregate payload words, reply words, and explicit live-byte allowance for one V4.1 expert-parallel prefill panel exchange.
rows.distinction: Transient wire-exchange geometry derived from routed rows and existing TPPlan owner bands, not tensor element ordering or context-region layout. Named live transport allocations do not cover RSS, device scratch, borrowed normalized input, or all-history Prefill outputs.

rows.definition: Validates the existing owner partition, routed picks, token/width bounds, every owner's encoded request size, response size, and explicit live transport allowance before creating v41EPPanelLayout.
rows.distinction: Bounds one exchange before allocation or I/O; does not select TPPlan partitions or estimate complete host/device model memory, and does not certify hardware execution or full-history memory use.
